title: HadCRUT and Berkeley Earth on one baseline
claim: After shifting Berkeley from 1951-1980 onto 1961-1990, the two annual series agree more closely than either agrees with an unrebased comparison.
result: On 1880-2020 the rebased root-mean-square difference is 0.050 K.
limit: Berkeley Earth land-ocean uses HadSST. Agreement over the ocean is not two independent observations.

title: Baseline window changes the reported warming
claim: The same HadCRUT series reads as a different warming when the zero is 1850-1900 rather than 1961-1990.
result: Mean anomaly 1995-2023 versus 1961-1990 is 0.620 K. The 1850-1900 mean of the published series is -0.357 K, so the same recent window is 0.977 K above 1850-1900.
limit: 1850-1900 is a warming reference, not a preindustrial control run.

title: PAGES 2k is not the instrumental target
claim: Where both the reconstruction median and the embedded Cowtan and Way target are finite, they differ by more than the rounding of a shared thermometer.
result: From 1850 to 2000 the root-mean-square difference is 0.075 K.
limit: The reconstruction is an April-March proxy ensemble. It is not substituted for HadCRUT.

title: Northern Hemisphere warming is faster
claim: The HadCRUT northern-hemisphere series warms faster than the southern-hemisphere series over 1970-2023.
result: The northern slope is 0.276 K per decade and the southern slope is 0.119 K per decade.
limit: These are hemisphere averages of one analysis, not independent land and ocean products.
sources: HadCRUT.5.1.0.0 northern and southern hemisphere annual summaries

title: Infilling changes coverage, not the existence of empty cells
claim: The analysis grid covers more of the map than the non-infilled grid. The non-infilled Arctic mean is only as complete as the cells that were observed.
result: In 2010 the mean cell coverage is 0.725 without infilling and 0.993 in the analysis. The non-infilled Arctic overlap mean is 1.756 K with coverage 0.356, against a global area mean of 0.648 K.
limit: A higher Arctic number on a sparse grid is not a complete Arctic average.

title: Pinatubo is visible in the natural-only emulation
claim: The 1991-1993 dip is carried by volcanic forcing. The historical emulation includes it. The natural-only emulation also includes it because volcanoes are in that experiment.
result: Mean HadCRUT anomaly over 1991-1993 is 0.205 K. The historical emulation is 0.208 K and the natural-only emulation is -0.118 K.
limit: Natural-only here is solar plus volcanic effective radiative forcing in the two-box model. It is not a hist-nat simulation.

title: Single-forcing fingerprints are collinear and still not DAMIP
claim: Least squares on the training window assigns scaling factors to the two-box CO2, aerosol, and natural fingerprints. A shuffled HadCRUT series fits those fingerprints worse.
result: Training R2 is 0.713 and the shuffled control R2 is 0.009. The condition number of the training Gram matrix is 702.8.
limit: These fingerprints are one emulator with the fitted parameters. They are not hist-GHG, hist-aer, or hist-nat.

title: The training optimum is on the prior boundary and loses to persistence
claim: The two-box search, confined to the declared prior and blind to 1995-2023, sits on the low-feedback edge. Persistence beats it on the holdout.
result: Lambda is 0.501 W m-2 K-1. The particle mean is 0.544, with a 5 to 95 percent range of 0.503 to 0.567. Holdout RMSE is 0.322 K against persistence 0.124 K.
limit: An equilibrium sensitivity of 3.93 divided by this lambda is not an assessed ECS. The fit wanted to leave the prior.

title: A spatial fit beats a uniform trend by a small margin
claim: Three seeds trained through 1994 have a lower holdout grid error than a latitude-uniform trend. The seed spread is part of the result. Inverse-RMSE weights favor the better seed without refitting.
result: Seed holdout errors are 0.779, 0.740, 0.705. The uniform trend is 0.801 K. Weights are 0.317, 0.333, 0.350.
limit: 2023 is outside the training forcing radius and is an abstention. This is not a test on a withheld model family.

title: Stabilize and decline are different conditional paths
claim: Holding the last assessed forcing and declining toward the 1990 forcing do not reach the same 2100 global anomaly. Neither path is an SSP.
result: In 2100 the held-forcing path is 2.66 K and the declining path is 1.65 K, both anomalies versus 1961-1990.
limit: Both paths use the boundary-value feedback from S08. A different prior would move 2100. No regional field is drawn past the observations.

title: Four ssp245 files do not share a calendar or a 1961-1990 baseline
claim: CanESM5, MIROC6, MPI-ESM1-2-LR, and HadGEM3-GC31-LL were read as annual tas. Their anomalies are against 2015-2019 in each file, which is not 1961-1990.
result: By 2020 those anomalies versus each file's 2015-2019 mean are CanESM5 0.33 K (365_day), HadGEM3-GC31-LL 0.10 K (360_day), MIROC6 -0.03 K (gregorian), MPI-ESM1-2-LR -0.00 K (proleptic_gregorian).
limit: This is one pathway, ssp245, and one member each. It is not a multi-pathway attribution and it is not comparable to the HadCRUT 1961-1990 anomaly without a further baseline shift that these files do not contain.

title: Energy inventory is a stock in zettajoules
claim: The file named earth_energy_imbalance.csv increases over time and is stored as heat content. It is not the forcing series.
result: The inventory total moves from 1.54 ZJ to 473.02 ZJ. The last years in the file are missing and stay missing.
limit: A flux would be the time difference divided by area. That derivative is not substituted for the ERF table.

title: piControl spread is much smaller than the ssp245 change
claim: Each model's own preindustrial-control global mean varies by about a tenth of a kelvin, while its ssp245 file warms by more than a kelvin across the same length of record.
result: Control standard deviations and ssp245 end anomalies versus 2015-2019, or versus the first five years of a branch that is not 2015, are CanESM5 control std 0.107 K (years 5366-5451) and ssp245 end 2.72 K, HadGEM3-GC31-LL control std 0.106 K (years 2015-2100) and ssp245 end 2.67 K, MIROC6 control std 0.128 K (years 3365-3450) and ssp245 end 1.78 K, MPI-ESM1-2-LR control std 0.122 K (years 2015-2100) and ssp245 end 1.46 K.
limit: HadGEM3 and MPI piControl files carry a time coordinate that reads 2015-2100. Those numbers are branch labels in the file, not historical years, and they are not drawn on the 1850-2100 chart. One member is not a model-family distribution.
sources: ClimateBench CMIP6.zip tas piControl and ssp245
